notes: Single source of truth for OpenSCAD host support. Read by dcc_mcp_openscad.compat (service side) and by doctor.py (lifecycle side). OpenSCAD version strings are calendar based: YYYY.MM for releases and YYYY.MM.DD for the dated development snapshots the project publishes between releases. A version outside `supported_ranges` is rejected explicitly; it is never silently downgraded.

supported_ranges.evidence: Real OpenSCAD 2021.01 end-to-end run in CI: status/validate/export STL/render PNG all executed, 1 passed / 0 skipped.

Real OpenSCAD 2026.09.29 snapshot end-to-end run in CI: same end-to-end path, 1 passed / 0 skipped. No adapter-visible break; the CLI flags the adapter passes are a strict superset of the 2021.01 surface.

breaking_changes.title: `--export-format` became available for STL/3MF/AMF/OFF selection
breaking_changes.symptom: Without the flag OpenSCAD infers the format from the output suffix; an unknown suffix silently produces no file instead of an error.
breaking_changes.remediation: The adapter passes `--export-format binstl|asciistl` for STL outputs and then reads the artifact back, so a missing or empty file is an explicit error instead of a reported success.

breaking_changes.title: `--summary-file` was added for machine-readable CGAL statistics
breaking_changes.symptom: Statistics are only printed to stdout on older hosts; parsing stdout for facet counts silently fails there.
breaking_changes.remediation: The adapter never parses the statistics stream; it reads the exported artifact back instead, which is version independent.

breaking_changes.title: The stdout geometry summary gained a `(PolySet)` qualifier
breaking_changes.symptom: 2021.01 prints `Top level object is a 3D object:` where 2026.09 prints `Top level object is a 3D object (PolySet):`; any stdout scraping keyed on the old line breaks.
breaking_changes.remediation: Nothing to do: the adapter reads artifacts back from disk rather than parsing OpenSCAD's stdout.
